title: Restore hydrating public entity constructors with deprecation notice instead of protected

violation.problem: Entity constructors were sealed to protected scope in codegen, causing TypeScript compilation errors on existing code using `new Project(client, id)` or `new Screen(client, id)`.
violation.expectedSolution: Restore public constructor visibility, properly hydrate entity identity from string ID or data object, register with the client identity map, and mark with @deprecated pointing to factory methods.
